description: This file defines the class 'EntityDataLoadContainer' which implements the 'Container' interface. It manages the process of loading data into the database, including reading data files, configuring database constraints, and orchestrating the data loading process within the OFBiz framework. It handles command line properties for data loading, manages constraints and indices, and provides detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: EntityDataLoadContainer
classes.description: This class manages the data loading process into the OFBiz database, handling constraints, indexes, and data file processing, as well as integrating with framework components and configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container, loads data for specified delegator(s), and manages configuration properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container, returning a boolean indicating successful start.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container, currently no operation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container's name.

methods.name: getTenantList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tenants for multi-tenant setups.

methods.name: loadDataForDelegator
methods.description: Executes the data loading process for a specific delegator with relevant configurations and constraints.

methods.name: isPropertySet
methods.description: Checks if a given property key is set to true or null in the provided properties map.

methods.name: getEntityGroupNameFromConfig
methods.description: Determines the entity group name from configuration or override.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves a delegator instance based on either an override name or configuration property.

methods.name: getDelegatorFromProp
methods.description: Creates delegator instance from configuration property.

methods.name: getBaseDelegator
methods.description: Returns the base delegator if the given delegator is tenant-specific.

methods.name: getHelperInfo
methods.description: Retrieves database helper info for a specific delegator and entity group.

methods.name: getModelEntities
methods.description: Fetches model entity mapping for a given delegator and entity group.

methods.name: createOrUpdateComponentEntities
methods.description: Ensures component entities are created or updated in the database.

methods.name: dropDbConstraints
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints, indices, and related database constraints.

methods.name: createDbConstraints
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints, indices, and related database constraints.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Drops primary keys from tables as needed.

methods.name: createPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Creates primary keys for tables.

methods.name: repairDbColumns
methods.description: Repairs database columns that require size or other modifications.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Main method to load data from files/URLs into the database, handling transaction options, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Parses transaction timeout setting from string.

methods.name: prepareDataUrls
methods.description: Prepares a list of data URLs from file, directory, component, and reader configurations.

methods.name: getLoadFiles
methods.description: Parses file property into a list.

methods.name: isDataReadersEnabled
methods.description: Determines if data readers should be used based on provided properties.

methods.name: prepareTenantLoadComponents
methods.description: Prepares list of components to load data for, based on tenant and configuration.

methods.name: retireveDataUrlsFromFileList
methods.description: Converts a list of filenames into URL objects for data loading.

methods.name: retrieveDataUrlsFromDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves URLs for all data files from a specified directory.

methods.name: logDataLoadingPlan
methods.description: Logs the plan for data loading based on URLs and delegator name.

methods.name: createDataLoadMessage
methods.description: Formats a message indicating the number of rows loaded from a data source.

methods.name: logDataLoadingResults
methods.description: Logs summary and errors after data load completes.
